fields.Name: T219 - AI Agent Run Visualization Tab
fields.Description: Opens a completed AI Agent Run and switches to the Visualization tab, verifying the run visualization renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'MJ: AI Agent Runs' entity grid — type 'AI Agent Runs' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the 'MJ: AI Agent Runs' node (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=MJ:%20AI%20Agent%20Runs). Click a row whose Status is 'Completed', then click 'Open Full Record'. The AI Agent Run detail opens with a header (the agent name e.g. 'Memory Manager', a COMPLETED badge, and Started/Completed/Duration/Result fields) and a row of tabs: Timeline, Visualization, Analytics, Details. Click the 'Visualization' tab. Verify the Visualization view renders a visual representation of the agent run (a graph / diagram / flow of the run's steps or execution), with no error. (Seeing the visualization render — not a specific shape — is success.) Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Completed AI Agent Run record opened
The 'Visualization' tab was selected and rendered a visual representation of the run (graph/diagram/flow)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
